derivation: adverb from a compound of G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of (to stretch);
def: in a well-strung manner, i.e. (figuratively) intensely (in a good sense, cogently; in a bad one, fiercely)

occurrences.text: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publickly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
